shots.purpose: Open on the drop: a droplet silhouette on the sea surface, interior crowded with glowing specks
shots.claim: a standard drop of surface seawater carries tens of thousands of bacteria and hundreds of thousands of viruses
shots.evidence: surface aqua gradient, dark droplet with luminous specks inside, wave line behind, 0.05 ml chip
shots.motion_reason: slow push-in toward the crowded interior

depth.note: specks float in front of the droplet body

subject_contract.expected_subject: crowded droplet silhouette on a surface sea gradient with glowing specks

shots.purpose: Composition by volume: water mass, split salt ions, thin living sliver highlighted
shots.claim: average ocean salinity is about 3.5%, dominated by sodium and chloride ions
shots.evidence: vertical composition bar: vast water field, paired Na/Cl ion dots, highlighted living sliver at the end

depth.note: ions drift in front of bar

subject_contract.expected_subject: composition bar with water mass, ion pairs and a highlighted life sliver

shots.purpose: First descent: the diatom in engraved detail, sunlight beams crossing its glass shell
shots.claim: diatoms produce roughly a fifth of global photosynthetic production
shots.evidence: geometric glass shell (hexagon-and-striae pattern) with aqua light beams, 100 um scale chip
shots.motion_reason: light beams sweep across the shell while the camera settles

subject_contract.expected_subject: engraved diatom shell with light beams and scale chip

shots.purpose: The microscopic middle: a bacterium beside a virus swarm; one cell bursts and dissolves outward
shots.claim: marine viruses repeatedly lyse bacteria, redirecting microbial biomass into dissolved organic matter
shots.evidence: large capsule-shaped bacterium, small dot-headed viruses swarming, one cell bursting into a diffusing cloud
shots.motion_reason: virus swarm converges; burst cloud expands

subject_contract.expected_subject: bacterium with virus swarm and one bursting cell diffusing outward

shots.purpose: Escalate upward from the small: molecules feed bacteria, bacteria feed grazers and fish larvae
shots.claim: the viral shunt's dissolved carbon feeds microbes that anchor the marine food web
shots.evidence: ascending arrow chain: speck cloud, bacterium, copepod outline, fish-larva silhouette

subject_contract.expected_subject: ascending food-web chain from specks to fish larva

shots.purpose: The molecular floor: paired ions drifting among dissolved gasses and organic specks
shots.claim: the drop's smallest inhabitants operate at sub-nanometre scale, a millionfold below bacteria
shots.evidence: paired glowing dots (Na+, Cl-) in a dark navy field with drifting organic specks, nm scale chip
shots.motion_reason: slow drift through the ion field

subject_contract.expected_subject: ion pairs and organic specks in deep navy with nm scale chip

shots.purpose: Resolve: the full scale ladder in one frame — drop, diatom, bacterium, virus, ion on one glowing line
shots.claim: a drop of seawater is a connected multi-scale ecosystem, from molecules to algae
shots.evidence: vertical ladder: droplet top, diatom, bacterium, virus, ion pair bottom, one aqua line linking all with amber size chips
shots.motion_reason: slow pull-back reveals the whole ladder

subject_contract.expected_subject: full scale ladder linked by one glowing line with size chips
